emails.body_text:
Hey Jimmy,

I was looking at mrgoodroof.com — huge respect for carrying Mr. GoodRoof's trusted Middle Tennessee reputation and GAF Master Elite standard.

One mobile conversion leak caught my eye: mrgoodroof.com has zero embedded quote form on the homepage — leaving Middle Tennessee mobile visitors with no instant way to check a wind/hail roof ballpark before calling.

So I built a working 30-second Nashville Roof Estimator in your deep-teal-and-red Mr. GoodRoof branding. Homeowners tap their roof size, slope, and material tier to see an honest local ballpark before leaving their name and phone.

Mind if I send over the live preview link?

— {{sender_name}}

{{sender_address}} | {{unsubscribe_line}}
emails.psychological_trigger: Value-First Reciprocity & Verified Site Gap Callout (zero links in Step 1)
Tangible Proof & Localized Nashville Rate Calibration

loom_60s_script.pain_comparison_15_35s: [SCREEN: Show current form / contact flow on mrgoodroof.com] "Here's the gap I caught: your homepage has zero interactive roof calculator, so Nashville homeowners checking storm replacement prices after hours have no quick way to engage."
loom_60s_script.live_demo_walkthrough_35_50s: [SCREEN: Switch tab to live Mr. GoodRoof MVP & tap Steps 1–4] "So I built a 29-kilobyte fix in your exact deep-teal-and-red branding. loom_60s_script.zero_pressure_cta_50_60s: [SCREEN: Point to 1-line embed bar at top] "Drops onto your homepage in five minutes with zero redesign. Reply if you'd like to put it live — either way, hope it helps."

objection_handlers.objection: Every Nashville roof has different decking, flashing, and code needs — I don't want online quotes boxing us in.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: 100% agree — this never issues a binding bid. It gives an honest Nashville & Middle TN ballpark range with a clear on-site inspection disclaimer so low-ball shoppers filter themselves out while qualified homeowners book already expecting real licensed pricing ($13,200–$18,000+).

objection_handlers.objection: We already get strong word-of-mouth referrals and repeat business.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: That local reputation is gold — and even referred neighbors still pull up mrgoodroof.com on their phone at 8pm before calling. A 30-second estimator simply captures ready-to-buy homeowners already visiting your site who want a ballpark before dialing.

objection_handlers.objection: Why pay $750 setup + $149/mo when we already have a website contact form?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Blind static forms leak mobile shoppers who bounce before typing 7+ fields. This drops directly onto your homepage, tags urgent Nashville storm and leak leads into your priority slot, updates regional pricing quarterly, and a single extra closed roof ($16,000+) pays for 3+ years.

objection_handlers.objection: I don't want anyone breaking or redesigning mrgoodroof.com.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Zero redesign required. It's a self-contained 29 KB vanilla JS script wrapped in Shadow DOM isolation so it cannot alter a single CSS rule on mrgoodroof.com — your web person pastes one line in 5 minutes.

objection_handlers.objection: Email me the numbers and I'll review it with my team.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Happy to — I'll send a clean 3-bullet recap ($750 one-time Nashville calibration & setup, $149/mo edge hosting, instant SMS/email routing, and quarterly updates, cancel anytime) plus the live link to tap through on your phone. Good to follow up Thursday morning?
